description: Which paid API should my agent call? Searches the 36,000+ paid x402 resources on the public x402 discovery indexes and returns how many match your need, how many seller hosts there are, and the top 3 services ranked by relevance, 30-day unique payers and calls, recency and price (service name, USD price, networks, payers). Optional max_price and network filters. Free preview tier. The paid x402 routes add resource URLs and usage detail for the top 5 (/v1/lite), live 402 checks of the top candidates with a best verified pick (/v1/pick) and a market report with price quartiles and top sellers (/v1/market).

max_price.description: Only resources priced at or below this many USD per call, e.g. 0.01

need.description: The capability you need, in plain words, e.g. "solana token safety", "web search", "pdf to text", "hyperliquid funding rates" (2-200 chars)

network.description: Only resources payable on this network (default any)

name: find_paid_api
title: Find a paid x402 API for a task (free preview)
